segments.caption: Bhai sarkaar ki phati badhiya. Sarkaar shuruaat isi patti
thi jis hisaab se inhonne media ko capture raha, aavaaz dab
ai and apna corruption chaaloo rakha. Lekin ab jis hisaab se
tum dekh rahe ho ki social media par post yah ban kar raha
hai logon ki account ban kar rahe hain. Kuchh nahin badal
sakta India mein siva ek revolution ke and ek revolution
mere hisaab se aana bahut zaroori hai ki bhai log aae bhai
tarike se protest karen kyonki freedom of speech bachi nah
in hai. Bhai aavaaz kisi ki bachi nahin hai ya garibi ki.
Saahab sun hi nahin jaati hai us par gaadiyaan loan dete ha
in bhai aur jo hote bane bhai aise likh ke nikal jaate hain
paise khila ke nikal jaate hain jis par paisa hai bhai us
par koi laws rules kaanoon kuchh apply hi nahin hota bhai.
And jis par nai bhi hai bhai vah BJP ki chaatukaarita karta
hai aur bhai yah pahunch jaate hain bhai saahab yah white
washing ho jaati hai inke oopar se saare cases hat jaate ha
in chaahe vah rape ke ho murder ke ho criminal cases ho sab
hat jaate hain. Chayan ki zindagi ji rahe hain, ash ki zind
agi ji rahe hain. Na bhai saahab aadmi ko hava mil rahi hai
na paani mil rahi hai. Ke time par gas bhi nahin mil rahi. Inhen kuchh fark thodi
pad raha hai, inhen kuchh to aphishon mein sab facilities
hai bhai baith ke sab kha rahe hain, pi rahe hain chayan se
. Inke loan deal apart hai, bhai sab baahar videsh mein padh
rahe hain. Yahaan par bhai saahab matlab thodi hai kuchh
education system se hi karna hai, health care se hi karni
hai. Inke lie to bhai bhaad mein ja bhai. Apna kaam banta
hai, bhaad mein ja jaanta. Bhai, revolution bhai, mere hisa
ab se to bhai, inka laabh zindaabaad. Revolution aana chaah
ie bhai aur phir chizen sahi honi chaahie kyonki,
Bhai kuchh nahin bachana is desh ka aur jo badal sakta hai y
ahi generation badal sakti hai. Abhi dekha hoga kis tarike
se galgoot evan New York City ka phir se abhi band bajaaya
inhonne. Bhai is kabhi zevar airport par dvaartan karaaya
inhonne yogi modi ne. Bhai kis tarike se lekar abhi samajh
rahe hain bhai saahab jansi aa jaenge bhai number van ja
enge inke. Bhai unhonne maar li tarike se inki jis tarike se
unhonne post daali reel bana bana ke lie ki bhai yah hai v
ah hai bhai nahin jhel paaya bhai inhonne baad mein post hat
ai hai unki bachchon ki. Desh bachaana hai apne aap ko.
Na apni bhai quality of life ki jara si bhi kadar hai na, b
hai jara asa aware ho lo bhai kya chal raha hai, mazaak se
hat ke bhai kyonki lagi badhiya duniya ki aur phir jo phish
iega na aam aadmi phishiega bhai yah to bhaiya hai aise ba
ithe rahenge saare ke saare.
